'''James Ward''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2001 Melbourne tournament]] on 8 April 2001 with [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|MWYHL]], according to Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2063">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-13-melbourne-australia-8-4-2001d2063/ melbourne-australia-8-4-2001], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 13 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-13-melbourne-australia-8-4-2001d2063/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
